_comment: Server-side inference (backend /api/vision/*): precision (sliced) detection, image-quality gate, ambiguity flag and reference comparison. Values marked 'empirical' cite the benchmark record they come from (docs/benchmarks/records/).

model.purpose: Registry id of the server detector (the same weights as the browser deep detector, so results agree).
model.ref: COCO val2017 (5000 held-out images): AP 40.2 at the YOLOX evaluation settings (published 40.5); see detection-yolox-s-coco-val2017-val2017-protocol.json

tile.purpose: Tile side of sliced inference in source pixels (precision mode).
tile.ref: SAHI defaults (Akyon et al., ICIP 2022, arXiv:2202.06934); replaced by the VisDrone tune-split sweep result when available.

fullImage.purpose: Also run the detector on the whole (downscaled) image, so large objects split by tiles are still found whole.
fullImage.ref: SAHI 'full inference' + slices (FI + SF) is its best configuration.

merge.purpose: How detections from tiles and the full image are combined: class-aware NMS, or greedy non-maximum merging (SAHI's union of boxes, 'nmm').
merge.ref: Chosen on 40 tune mosaics (COCO val2017 images 360-719, 3x3, 1920x1920): AP 38.9 with NMS vs 34.3 with SAHI's NMM (IoS 0.5); test mosaics (images 0-359): 36.9 vs 31.2 (detection-mosaic-tiling-* records). Same merge as the browser (config/vision.json deep.tiling).

matchMetric.purpose: Overlap measure for merging: IoU for NMS ('ios', intersection over the smaller box, is SAHI's choice for NMM).
matchMetric.ref: Paired with merge 'nms' in the mosaic benchmark.

matchThreshold.purpose: Overlap at which two detections of the same class are merged.
matchThreshold.ref: IoU 0.5 in the mosaic benchmark (config/vision.json deep.tiling.mergeIou).

maxTiles.purpose: Upper bound on tiles per image (larger tiles are used when exceeded).
maxTiles.ref: Bounds server time on very large images; a 4000x3000 photo at 640 px tiles and 0.2 overlap needs 48 tiles.

timeBudgetMs.purpose: Stop processing further tiles after this time; the response then says analysis_incomplete and which part was not analysed at full resolution.
timeBudgetMs.ref: Keeps one request well below typical 30-60 s proxy timeouts on small CPU instances.

secondClassRatio.purpose: A detection is reported as 'ambiguous' when its second-best class score is at least this fraction of its best class score.
secondClassRatio.ref: Untuned rule; how well it separates wrong-class detections from correct ones is measured on COCO val2017 (see docs/EVALUATION_PROTOCOL.md).

minBrightness.purpose: Below this mean luminance the image is reported as too dark for 'not detected' to be meaningful.
minBrightness.ref: Replaced by the threshold measured with tools/evaluate.py quality (synthetic low light on COCO val2017) when available.

minSharpness.unit: 0..1 (log variance of Laplacian, as config/vision.json signals)
minSharpness.purpose: Below this sharpness the image is reported as too blurred for 'not detected' to be meaningful.
minSharpness.ref: Replaced by the threshold measured with tools/evaluate.py quality (synthetic blur on COCO val2017) when available.

minShortSide.purpose: Images whose short side is below this are too small to analyse reliably.
minShortSide.ref: At 160 px a 640-px detector input upsamples 4x; COCO 'small' objects (< 32x32 px at full size) are then a few pixels.

inputSize.purpose: Square input size of the patch-feature extractor for reference comparison.
inputSize.ref: Size used for the VisA evaluation (anomaly-detection-patchcore-resnet50-visa-*.json).

minReferences.purpose: Fewest known-good reference images accepted (the decision threshold is set by leave-one-out over them).
minReferences.ref: Leave-one-out needs at least two references. How results change with the number of references is not measured yet (tools/evaluate.py anomaly on VisA).

maxReferences.purpose: Most reference images accepted per request (bounds time and memory: 10 x 784 patch features of 1024 floats = 32 MB).
maxReferences.ref: Bounds request time and memory; not tuned (the VisA evaluation in tools/evaluate.py anomaly has no recorded result yet).

thresholdMargin.purpose: Decision threshold = this factor x the highest leave-one-out score among the references.
thresholdMargin.ref: 1.0 = the most anomalous known-good reference. tools/evaluate.py anomaly applies the same rule on VisA; no result is recorded yet.

regionMinAreaFraction.purpose: Smallest above-threshold region reported as an anomaly region.
regionMinAreaFraction.ref: Suppresses isolated pixels of the smoothed anomaly map.

maxSide.purpose: Workspace comparison: both photos are reduced to this long side for registration and change detection (never enlarged).
maxSide.ref: Enough ORB features for a desk photo while keeping the server under a second per pair on one CPU thread.

orbFeatures.purpose: ORB keypoints per photo for registration.
orbFeatures.ref: OpenCV ORB (Rublee et al., ICCV 2011); default is 500, more keypoints make cluttered scenes register more reliably.

ratioTest.purpose: Lowe's ratio test for feature matches.
ratioTest.ref: Lowe, IJCV 2004 (0.8 in the paper; 0.75 is the common OpenCV tutorial value).

ransacReprojectionPx.purpose: RANSAC inlier distance for the homography.
ransacReprojectionPx.ref: OpenCV findHomography accepts 1-10 px; 4 px at 1024 px is about 0.4% of the frame.

minInliers.purpose: Fewest RANSAC inliers for a registration to be accepted.
minInliers.ref: Held-out synthetic benchmark (desk scenes 60-117, tools/evaluate.py workspace): all 170 related pairs registered, 0 of 40 unrelated pairs accepted (workspace-diff-*-test record).

minInlierRatio.purpose: Fewest share of ratio-test matches that must agree on the homography.
minInlierRatio.ref: Unrelated photos give scattered matches that rarely agree.

minOverlap.purpose: The registered current photo must cover at least this share of the reference; otherwise positions are not compared.
minOverlap.ref: Comparing positions over less than half of the scene would mostly report objects outside the shared view.

maxAreaChange.purpose: Rejects registrations that rescale the frame area by more than this factor (implausible for the same workspace).

unchangedIou.purpose: A same-category object whose registered box overlaps the reference box at least this much is unchanged.
unchangedIou.ref: The COCO/PASCAL match criterion (IoU 0.5) used throughout this project's evaluations.

maxMove.purpose: A same-category object displaced by less than this is reported as moved; farther apart they count as removed and added.
maxMove.ref: About a third of the frame: a cup moved across a desk is still the same cup.

diffThreshold.purpose: Per-pixel difference, after registration and exposure matching, that counts as a change.
diffThreshold.ref: Held-out synthetic benchmark: changed regions found 91% of added and 95% of removed objects, with 0.03 false regions per unchanged pair after an exposure change (workspace-diff-*-test record). Real lighting changes (shadows, reflections) also exceed it, so regions are reported as measurements, not as object changes.

blurSigma.purpose: Gaussian smoothing before differencing (suppresses residual misalignment and sensor noise).

minRegionArea.ref: About a coin on a desk photographed at arm's length.

minObjectChange.purpose: An object reported as added, removed or moved must have at least this share of changed pixels in its box (both places for a move); otherwise the detectors merely disagree and it is listed as uncertain.
minObjectChange.ref: Chosen on tune scenes 0-39 (tools/evaluate.py workspace): the largest value without loss of object-change recall; it cut false object changes on unchanged pairs from 0.80 to 0.00 per pair (0.25 already lost recall). Held-out scenes 60-117: 0.00 per unchanged pair, 0.30 per pair with a real change (workspace-diff-* records).
